text: When borrowing a tool from a neighbour, agree a return time as well as the loan; it makes sharing easier to plan and avoids awkward uncertainty.
The Japanese art of origami turns one sheet into intricate forms through folds alone; its playful engineering shows how constraint can spark remarkable invention.
For a quick sound experiment, hum while gently pinching your nose, then release it; notice how the nasal passage changes the resonance you hear.
